title: Cyberwave Twin Flight State
description: Whether an aircraft is airborne, as the aircraft itself reports it. Published on {prefix}cyberwave/twin/{twin_uuid}/flight_state on a plain interval with no change guard, so a reader can expire the value when the reports stop. An aircraft whose airborne state is not yet known publishes nothing rather than guessing. Identified by its topic, not by a field: the payload carries no contract id.

source_type.description: Runtime that produced the report: edge for a real aircraft, sim for a simulated one. Same vocabulary as source_type.envelope.v1.

timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds at which the aircraft sampled the state.

session_id.description: Driver session the report belongs to, when the driver runs inside one; absent or null outside one.

is_flying.description: Whether the aircraft is airborne. A boolean, never a string: consumers reject anything else rather than coerce it.

flight_mode.description: The aircraft's flight mode name in its own vocabulary, e.g. GPS_ATTI (DJI) or LOITER (ArduPilot). For display. Absent or empty means not reported on this tick, not that the mode was cleared.
